requirements.text: When the first valid AccCommand frame is received, the AccMonitor shall enter MONITORING and check that command.
While in MONITORING, the AccMonitor shall grant the permit and report the E2E counter of the last AccCommand that passed every check as the approved counter.
If an AccCommand requests more than 2.1 m/s2 acceleration or more than 3.6 m/s2 deceleration, then the AccMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason REQUEST_LIMIT.
If an AccCommand requests acceleration and deceleration at the same time, then the AccMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason ACCEL_AND_BRAKE.
If an AccCommand requests acceleration or deceleration while its status is not ACTIVE, then the AccMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason REQUEST_OUTSIDE_ACTIVE.

If the acceleration request rises faster than 3.5 m/s3 or the deceleration request rises faster than 6 m/s3 between two consecutive valid AccCommands, then the AccMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason REQUEST_RATE.

If an AccCommand requests acceleration that did not decrease by at least 4 m/s3 since the previous valid AccCommand while a valid radar target at most 200 m ahead and at most 1.8 m from the lane centre has a time to collision below 3 s, or while no valid RadarObject frame was received for 120 ms, then the AccMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason UNINTENDED_ACCEL.
If in MONITORING no valid AccCommand frame is received for 60 ms, then the AccMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason COMMAND_TIMEOUT.
While in SAFE_STATE, the AccMonitor shall withdraw the permit and report the reason of the first violation until the next power cycle.
The AccMonitor shall send the AccMonitorStatus message every 20 ms with E2E protection.

tests.name: S01_CommandsInsideTheEnvelopeAreApprovedAndApplied
tests.scenario: Commands inside the envelope are approved and applied

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 100 km/h
And the controller is ACTIVE without request
When 0.2 s pass
Then the monitor state is MONITORING
And the permit is granted
When the controller ramps the acceleration request to 2.0 m/s2 at 2.5 m/s3
And the controller ramps the deceleration request to 3.5 m/s2 at 5.0 m/s3
And 1 s pass
Then the monitor never entered SAFE_STATE
And the actuator applied every command
And the actuator applies -3.5 m/s2
And the actuator does not request a driver takeover
And every monitor frame passed the E2E check
And one monitor frame was sent per 20 ms
